title: The Last Stair
text: One stair left, narrow and dark, its steps worn hollow by things that were not feet. At the top, the thing you came to kill is waiting. You can hear it breathing. Whoever goes first will meet its first blow alone.

options.label: The hardiest goes up first, to meet its first blow.

outcomes.text: They take the first blow on their shield and their body, and the rest come up behind them whole.

options.label: Go up together, shoulder to shoulder.

outcomes.text: Shoulder to shoulder, no one first, no one last, into the breathing dark.
